UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Sankalan-t user account record created upon Google/Gmail sign-in.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified Gmail address associated with the account (PII; owner-only).

displayName.description: User's chosen display name shown on their profile and feedback.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when account is created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on profile updates.

FeedbackEntry.title: FeedbackEntry
FeedbackEntry.description: Community feedback entry posted from Settings Feedback Bar and visible to signed-in users.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the feedback author.

authorName.description: Public author display name (no email/PII stored).

status.description: Publication state used for rule-enforced community listing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when feedback is posted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on feedback edit.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user account profiles storing Gmail and display name.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Community feedback comments posted via the Settings feedback bar.
